newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: Trinidad robber escapes in puff of smoke.
newsitem.headline: Trinidad robber escapes in puff of smoke.

text.p: A bank robber in Trinidad literally escaped in a cloud of smoke following a successful heist.

A gunman held up the Republic bank in Rio Claro on Wednesday, forcing security guards, customers and staff to lie on the floor while he stuffed cash into a brown bag, the Trinidad Express reported on Thursday.
Police arrived on the scene but as the man fled down the street he hurled a cannister. Clouds of pink smoke billowed out, enabling him to elude pursuing police.
"I thought these things only happened in the movies," one witness told the newpaper.
